meta.descricao: The school of militant education of the Lúcia Revolutionary Front, popular and free, for anyone with an account on the site: a path, a class and a record of what you studied.

entrada.linhaNaoUniversidade: A school of militant education, popular and free, with the same account as the Community. Here no one pays and no one profits: you get a path, a class and a record of what you studied.

passos.texto: Say what you want and how much time you have. No name, email or ID: your enrolment stays on your device.
Pick a course built only from lessons that already exist at the Instituto.
If you like, study together with others taking the same course.
Take what you learned beyond the screen: at work, at home, in your neighbourhood.
At the end, a graduation and the record book of what you studied.

entrada.campusTexto: The School's buildings: lessons, library, labs, radio and community.
entrada.oQueETexto: The house of militant education of the Lúcia Revolutionary Front, inside the Instituto Lúcia: a people's school for working women and men. The courses are built from lessons that already exist on the site, in order, with estimated hours, a class to study with, a task in the world and a final project.
entrada.contaTexto: You come in with your Instituto Lúcia account, the same one you use in the Community. What you study is kept on this device.
entrada.mapaLead: The parts of the School, by topic. The bar at the top leads to the most used ones.
